summary: Implemented the rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py gains an iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ (explicit stack, level counter, 4-cell indent) and imports Measurement; rich/align.py gains Align.__repr__, a width constraint in Align.__rich_console__ (measured maximum, or min with explicit width), and a new VerticalCenter class with render, measure, and repr methods; rich/console.py passes justify="default" into render options in print; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added section containing the two entries; tests/test_align.py adds repr, VerticalCenter render, and measurement tests; tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds test_measure_tree expecting Measurement(11, 19). Tests were not run, per instructions; all verification was by reading. Nothing was committed.
